choice.basis: The task requires selecting the state with the highest incidence from the dashboard to route into the priority follow-up workflow. The chart legend indicates that dark red represents the lowest incidence (0) and light yellow represents the highest incidence (100). Among the options provided, Missouri (MO) is colored light yellow, indicating it has the highest incidence value compared to Mississippi (MS), which is dark red (low incidence), and Delaware (DE), which is orange (mid-range incidence). Therefore, Missouri is the correct record to open for the highest-incidence priority workflow.
choice.option_label: Open Missouri (MO) incidence detail for priority follow-up
